description: Client-side script for managing WAN status display and interactions on a web page, including layout preparation, UI initialization, dialog setup, and data fetching.

methods.name: _prepare_layout
methods.description: Prepares HTML table layout for IPv4 and IPv6 WAN connections, inserting rows with connection info and 'more' buttons.

methods.name: set_ui_init
methods.description: Initializes the UI with WAN IPv4 and IPv6 data, populating tables with connection details.

methods.name: set_dialog_init
methods.description: Populates a dialog with detailed information about a specific WAN connection based on provided data.

methods.name: clicked
methods.description: Handles click events on 'more' buttons to show detailed WAN connection info in a dialog.

methods.name: scrolled
methods.description: Synchronizes horizontal scrolling of table headers with content.

methods.name: get_info_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful data fetch, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: get_info_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for data fetch error, handles error scenarios like session timeout.

methods.name: get_info_data
methods.description: Fetches WAN status data from API.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes page by starting data fetch and showing loading indicator.
